summary.prose: The plan preserves completed T1–T13 and adds six dependency-ordered corrective tasks from approved LLD revision4. T15–T18 bound prepared storage, construction and every lifecycle consumer; T19 measures and corrects admission latency; T20 qualifies the complete production cutover. Retained T14 runs last with its original full-workload performance and package gates. Existing caps, exact scope/history, independent code review and human BUILD approval remain; no intermediate deployment or original-review resume is authorized.

tasks.title: Retain workload fixture and establish managed baseline
tasks.summary: Capture the 171-file/four-attempt descriptor and baseline using disposable registered projects, real managed Git/native paths and deterministic model stubs.
acceptanceChecks: Reproducible fixture preserves exact selected scope, histories and origins; records host/load, source-query and persistence metrics without touching stopped attempt4.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Proposed retained-fixture baseline: real managed Git, exact171-file/four-attempt scope and operation/write counters; deterministic provider not called before ready.

tasks.title: Define versioned preparation and operational contracts
tasks.summary: Add proposed exact checkpoint3, RuntimeV1, source manifest, HistoryBindingV1, cleanup claim and private capability types/decoders in existing shared review areas.
acceptanceChecks: Both family and supported historical readers reject unknown/mismatched required formats; runtime <=256KiB and client-forged authority rejected.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Proposed exact contracts: supported historical/version3 checkpoint decode, RuntimeV1 bound, manifest/history/cleanup binding identity and forged capabilities.

tasks.title: Implement compact host runtime durability
tasks.summary: Implement the sole-main-writer compact runtime persistence adapter and verify it through the real ReviewNativeHost/ReviewProcessLeases boundary. Preserve atomic save outcomes and host closure proof. Do not activate production storage before t7-t12 integration and coordinated cutover.
acceptanceChecks: At the compact adapter/native-host boundary: open intent precedes spawn; closure requires confirmed disposal; uncertain writes retain fences; native/progress updates leave full history unchanged. Production public-route wiring is required in t12/t13, not this foundation task.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Compact adapter/native-host integration: open-before-spawn, disposal-before-close, uncertain writes, injected initialization interruption, actual proof replacement and zero full-history native/progress updates; production wiring qualified in t12/t13.

tasks.title: Implement reserved disk-backed source sessions
tasks.summary: Extend RegistryReviewSources with exact query coalescing, existing cat-file batching, verified staging/index and per-project capacity reservations.
acceptanceChecks: Zero duplicate physical queries across historical/current consumers, including above-memory workload; logical per-packet budgets unchanged; pinned disk exhaustion fails before batch.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Proposed source-session tests: batching/framing/hash equivalence, per-packet budgets, above-memory disk retention, aggregate reservation exhaustion and zero duplicate queries.

tasks.title: Implement stable qualified source contexts and private borrows
tasks.summary: Add proposed shared preparation acquisition around existing validators, immutable staged-ready manifests and current-epoch host receipts, with bounded main metadata.
acceptanceChecks: Warm authorized handoff reuses verified sources after terminal worker reclamation; tampered files revoke receipt; cold daemon restart never trusts disk alone.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Proposed context acquisition tests: private worker receipts/borrows, ready ordering, warm cross-worker handoff, tamper/restart invalidation and eviction restrictions.

tasks.title: Implement successor history validation and result commits
tasks.summary: Separate stable source generation from immutable validated feedback/history bindings; validate deltas, attribution/origins and newly referenced evidence.
acceptanceChecks: Normal feedback and publication bookkeeping never rebuild unchanged sources; changed earlier history invalidates descendants; committed feedback reconciles runtime without model rerun.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Proposed history binding tests: successive task/chunk feedback and new evidence, old-history tamper, checkpoint/runtime crash reconciliation and no source/model rerun.

tasks.title: Integrate code review preparation across routes
tasks.summary: Route admission, packet projection, task/story execution and explicit recovery through shared preparation, preserving all selected spans and pinned history. Deliver private adapters consumed by existing coordinator/worker dependency seams and exercise them in focused integration fixtures. Production runtime selection is activated only in the coordinated t12 cutover after host and lifecycle dependencies exist.
acceptanceChecks: Through the shared family adapter, Epic/standalone/ISSUE/LLD-only/no-document routes and aliases preserve exact scope; no generic HEAD diff or skipped modules; immutable attempts remain pinned.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

This task gates the complete family adapter and its focused tests, not default production selection. It must expose execution/recovery seams for t9/t12; full production activation is mandatory in t12 and independently qualified in t13. No feature flag, parallel review engine or incomplete production cutover.

tests.name: Extend route-admission/projection-lineage/final-scope tests: all workflow story/task routes, merge/rename/delete witnesses, aliases and exact selected after blocks.

tasks.title: Integrate design review latest-subject preparation
tasks.summary: Route subject capture, planning/impact/chunks and explicit recovery through same lifecycle with design-specific latest target/ancestry checks. Deliver private adapters consumed by existing coordinator/worker dependency seams and exercise them in focused integration fixtures. Production runtime selection is activated only in the coordinated t12 cutover after host and lifecycle dependencies exist.
acceptanceChecks: Through the shared family adapter, DEF/HLD/LLD route matrix passes; relevant target changes invalidate and await human restart; unrelated edits ignored; prompts use paths, not artifact bodies.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

This task gates the complete family adapter and its focused tests, not default production selection. It must expose execution/recovery seams for t9/t12; full production activation is mandatory in t12 and independently qualified in t13. No feature flag, parallel review engine or incomplete production cutover.

tests.name: Extend design subject-monitor/recovery tests: latest DEF/HLD/LLD routes, impact/chunk reuse, target invalidation/user restart and unrelated edit stability.

tasks.title: Add exact cancellation and preparation progress surfaces
tasks.summary: Extend worker control and both public MCP/daemon surfaces plus supported IPC DTOs for cancellation and bounded genuine preparation counters. Implement the private host-to-worker bridge for the main-owned per-project capacity allocator, runtime store and context registry; retain exact per-review allocation ownership across worker reclamation and release only after proven file cleanup.
acceptanceChecks: Exact owner-only cancel prevents new work, stops only selected worker, reports honest resource fences; polling creates no activity; both clients agree with enums.
Cancel/spawn/candidate/publication races preserve exact ownership and already committed results; progress counters reflect genuine completed operations only.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

Private worker ports bind capacity/runtime/context requests to the exact current review owner and phase; workers cannot instantiate separate project allocators or mint context/runtime authority. Test the bridge before t12 activation.

tests.name: Extend worker isolation/progress/recovery and MCP wire fixtures: cancel exact review during preparation/tool/model/publication races, owner rejection, resource fence and nullable genuine counters.
Private preparation bridge tests: exact worker/review ownership, aggregate project capacity, split/combine allocation retention, context/runtime receipts, worker reclamation and cleanup-only release.

tasks.title: Integrate publication and approval with new proof
tasks.summary: Use qualified context/history/runtime proof for both publishers and approval freshness; emit supported new permanent CR capabilities with complete saved history/audit.
acceptanceChecks: Publication retries use zero model calls, warm matching publication has no source reconstruction, permanent history is self-contained and independently validated.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Extend both-family publication/approval tests: complete new CR capabilities, warm zero reconstruction, publication-only retry zero model calls and current-author/BUILD freshness.

tasks.title: Implement resumable cleanup claims for both families
tasks.summary: Extend existing design private-claim pattern to exact multi-file cleanup; preserve closed audit/permanent proof, sync claim before destructive deletes, delete claim last.
acceptanceChecks: Crash after each deletion resumes cleanup-only without Git/model calls; missing runtime without claim stays fenced; current approval and file identities rechecked; unrelated files retained.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Extend both-family cleanup tests: fault every claim/rename/unlink/fsync boundary; cleanup retry after runtime/checkpoint removal, approval/file mismatch and arbitrary missing-runtime refusal.

tasks.title: Implement explicit inactive-record migration and coordinated cutover
tasks.summary: Migrate supported old inactive records under exact fences; preserve inputs/results/actions and unresolved guards; wire all production consumers to new execution without flags or legacy dual writers.
acceptanceChecks: Interrupted migration never loses proof; old-only rollback rejected after new formats; no automatic scans/resume, no partial daemon deployment or stopped-attempt restart.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

Wire the real production review ownership, both-family checkpoint/native resource, progress, publication, approval and cleanup paths to compact runtime; no test-only adapter or legacy active-writer fallback remains for new execution.

Activate the t7/t8 shared family preparation adapters and t9 host bridge through every production task/story admission, execution, explicit recovery and publication path; remove old active-writer selections in this same cutover. Test-only adapters do not satisfy this task.

tests.name: Proposed migration/cutover tests: inactive v1/v2 byte-preserving upgrade, legacy guards, interrupted migration, unknown capabilities and unsupported old-reader downgrade.

tasks.title: Qualify failure, concurrency and scope equivalence
tasks.summary: Run both-family production fixtures covering all route matrices, source equivalence, tampering, write windows, native disposal, cancellation and cleanup/migration crashes.
acceptanceChecks: Two independent review sessions remain isolated; full-history writes/native command=0; all mandatory source/test coverage preserved; no user socket/DB or hosted quota used.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.
Through actual registered production review routes, prove native resource and progress writes perform zero full-history mutations for both code and design reviews.
Repeat all t7/t8 route, alias, merge/rename/delete witness, exact-selected-span and latest-subject invariants through actual production defaults for both families.

tests.name: Full disposable production two-session matrix through public routes and both families, all crash/tamper/native-loss cases, complete scope equivalence and bounded runtime writes.

tasks.title: Stage typed packet descriptors with bounded memory ownership
tasks.summary: Extend the existing prepared-context codec/store with proposed typed packet/task/file descriptor indexes, bounded leaf/window access and explicit release; unify live-memory charging with source staging and host disk reservations. Add derived encoding version checks without changing pinned history or CRs.
acceptanceChecks: Document and implement descriptor lookup, bounded window acquisition/release and cancellation ownership in existing review-context modules; no new DB or eager compatibility path.

Reserve before allocation for shared binary buffers, UTF-16 strings, metadata/index shards and encoder/decoder scratch; release only after final owner. Staged immutable leaves retain complete content/digests and aggregate disk reservation.

Round-trip byte arrays, Unicode, null/undefined and ordered descriptor references; reject unknown/old derived encodings and foreign/tampered objects before use. Partial generation never grants readiness; unchanged64MiB memory/256MiBcache/4MiBbatch defaults.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Typed staged descriptor/leaf codec and shared memory accounting: byte/Unicode/null/order round-trip, shard/version/tamper rejection, reserve-before-allocation and exact window release.
Staged view capacity ownership: aggregate disk reservations, partial sealing, borrowed-window cancellation and two-session memory/disk pressure retain complete evidence.

tasks.title: Bound packet projection and history qualification construction
tasks.summary: Convert existing packet/projection/history preparation to stage each validation window and retain bounded descriptor/lineage indexes instead of whole prepared packets and historical inventories.
acceptanceChecks: Cold/current/historical construction keeps exact selected spans, rename/delete/replacement/merge witnesses, commit provenance, tests/documents and complete feedback/origin validation; logical per-packet projection limits still apply on source-cache hits.

No JSON.stringify of binary packet payloads for size/digest, aggregate packets/inputs array or full-history clone. Fold ordered descriptor identities with explicit version/domain; release one window before opening next without duplicate physical source acquisition.

Single-packet and repeated-history content beyond decoded memory budget but within reserved disk completes semantic qualification with combined charged memory<=configured cap; genuine unbounded atomic unit fails before allocation with exact stage/size/bound.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Incremental packet/projection/history equivalence: exact selected after spans, all lineage/replacement/merge/deletion witnesses, tests/documents/origins and identity folds match the existing oracle.
Single oversized packet and1/4/max history construct staged views under combined memory bound with zero physical duplicate source queries and no aggregate binary JSON materialization.

tasks.title: Use bounded views in execution and mandatory coverage assessment
tasks.summary: Convert code/design assessment adapters, selected-code extraction, prompt assembly and test-coverage readers to bounded task/file windows under current private generation borrows.
acceptanceChecks: Complete submitted review scope and mandatory test-coverage assessment remain identical for task/whole-story routes; no module omitted because of size. Test execution remains optional, scope and coverage do not.

Final prompt assembly, serialization and provider transport copies are included in memory reservations/high-water instrumentation; do not hide whole-task/whole-packet hydration behind a lazy accessor.

Borrow/release/cancel rules hold through provider/native consumption; no source/provider use from unqualified or revoked descriptors. Keep existing model capability and CLI provider path; design prompts use current paths, not copied artifacts.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Bounded execution and mandatory coverage traversal for code/design task/story routes: no skipped modules, prompt/provider transport copies charged, borrow invalidation/cancellation and no premature provider dispatch.

tasks.title: Use staged views across recovery publication and cleanup
tasks.summary: Convert warm/cold phase handoff, history binding/evidence, publication and approval cleanup to the same bounded descriptor traversal; remove aggregate reader.view inventory loading.
acceptanceChecks: Matching authorized warm handoff/publication/cleanup reconstructs zero sources and invokes zero models; cold restart discards authority and fully qualifies required scope/history once with bounded windows.

All pinned submitted values, feedback/actions/failures and origin witnesses survive exact publication/permanent round-trip; old derived encoding cannot become authority or trigger unsafe cache deletion.

Preserve result-before-progress ordering, native open/disposal fences and durable cleanup-only claim; canceled active windows and partial stage/seal/promotion/reopen/cleanup failures retain exact evidence/reservations and allow only explicit safe recovery.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Bounded warm/cold recovery publication and cleanup: full feedback round-trip, zero warm source/model calls, old derived version rejection, history/native/cleanup crash and authority invariants.

tasks.title: Trace and correct measured admission latency
tasks.summary: Instrument public admission request, registration, stored guard/scope checks, worker startup, checkpoint/runtime binding, activation and acknowledgement; correct only the measured slow path while preserving durable acknowledgement.
acceptanceChecks: Record cold/warm monotonic segment timings and causal attribution for the observed2831ms baseline; no assumed Git/model bottleneck.

Source/projection/history qualification stays in dedicated registered background workers; any moved expensive pre-ack derivation retains equivalent current owner/author/route/guard validation and bounded DTOs.

Acknowledgement follows proven durable input/runtime activation; no provisional success, skipped checks, duplicate dispatch or detached work. Controlled two-review admit/cancel<=2s and progress-gap<=2s with failure/cancel races verified.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

tests.name: Measured admission segment attribution and durable-ack two-session race matrix: controlled admit/cancel<=2s, progress gap<=2s, complete owner/guard/binding checks and no duplicate dispatch.

tasks.title: Qualify the complete staged-view production cutover
tasks.summary: Wire the revised writer and every lifecycle consumer together in the actual production defaults, then run focused bounded-view correctness/capacity/crash and source-free package regressions before retained T14 timing qualification.
acceptanceChecks: Both families and all epic/standalone/issue/task/story/document routes use the new store; no eager packet Map or aggregate whole-view reader remains reachable through production preparation/execution/publication/recovery/cleanup.

Instrumented actual-source managed fixture proves combined memory reservation bound, zero repeated physical queries, unchanged projection/history/permanent results, runtime<=256KiB and zero full-checkpoint writes/native command.

Two-session memory/disk contention, borrowed-window cancellation, tampered shards/leaves, version rejection and crash windows retain existing native/cleanup authority; full scope cannot be replaced by small synthetic tests.
npm build and source-free package smoke pass with code/design daemon/controller paths. These regressions do not substitute for T14's full coldx3/warm/history-growth/concurrent performance gates.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; no intermediate adapter completion authorizes deployment or resumes the stopped review.

Verify persisted plan/build scheduling follows explicit order/dependencies: next runnable corrective task t15 and final qualification t14 only after t20; preserve exact t1-t13 definitions/test mappings and passed BUILD/TESTS entries.

tests.name: Actual production staged-view cutover matrix for both families and all workflow routes: combined memory high-water, complete scope/history equality, zero duplicate queries/full-history hot writes, cancellation/tamper/crash fences and task-order preservation.
Source-free compiled package code/design daemon/controller smoke plus backend build after bounded-view cutover; retained full T14 workload remains an independent final gate.

tasks.title: Qualify performance, packaging and deployment handoff
tasks.summary: Measure full managed cold/warm/history-growth workloads, build shipped package and document coordinated restart plus explicitly authorized post-deployment smoke.
acceptanceChecks: Three cold-run median<=120s, warm<=10s, controlled admit/cancel<=2s and progress observation<=2s; report all metrics; failed gates block old qualification; deployment awaits BUILD approval.
Task completion uses local managed qualification and package checks only. Deployment smoke requires later approved BUILD, user update/restart and explicit permission to retrigger original review.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

tests.name: Managed cold x3/warm/history-growth performance gates on supported Node/native package, npm build plus source-free package smoke; no deployed daemon mutation.

testStrategyCoverage.lldStrategyItem: Existing projection/lineage oracle: unchanged code scope identities, after-segments, deletion/rename/merge/replacement witnesses and test/document bytes across baseline and new preparation.
Counting ReviewSources fixture: exact query keys, all prior/current packets in one session, duplicate coalescing, deterministic error attribution and no negative/error poisoning.

Stable source generation excludes accepted feedback; immutable successor history binding validates new results/origins. Tampering with old feedback revokes descendants; input/source changes invalidate source qualification.
Logical ProjectionBudget read/byte/fragment limits apply independently per packet even when physical reads are reused.
Exact runtime and checkpoint decoders: foreign identity, oversized fields, missing/unknown capabilities, forbidden paths, stale sequences and impossible completion states.
Code story/task and epic/standalone/issue/no-document route matrix; design DEF/HLD/LLD latest-subject matrix.
Full checkpoint input/feedback remains pinned while compact runtime is sole new hot resource authority.
Client/model-supplied qualification handles, PIDs, native closure claims and approval receipts are rejected.
Cancel and preparation progress wire fixtures preserve enum/status meaning, nullable unknown totals and actual counters; no invented task inventory or percentage.
Supported historical checkpoint/CR readers and explicit new-format capability mismatch refusals before cleanup or execution.

ProductionReviews through registered MCP/IPC routes acquires context, runs each family with a deterministic reviewer, preserves full feedback, publishes, approves under fixture authority and cleans only approved inactive targets.
Real Git batch output, object hash/type/framing, read-only isolation, exact missing-object semantics and byte limits through ReviewNativeHost/ReviewProcessLeases.

Warm handoff to a new authorized publication/cleanup worker reuses a private receipt after terminal execution-worker reclamation; cold daemon restart invalidates all receipts and requalifies through authoritative sources once.
Author changes before restart use fresh production scope, not a test-only resolver; latest design target edits invalidate and wait for human-approved restart; unrelated external edits do not loop.
Two review sessions retain separate ownership, progress, cancellation and resource fences; cancel one during preparation, assessment and publication-boundary races without affecting the other.
Observe actual runtime/history writer bytes and commit ordering: native open/close writes0 full history records, result commit precedes counted completion, and open intent precedes subprocess spawn.
Multiple accepted task/chunk results plus publication bookkeeping preserve source receipt and use zero repeated Git qualification; new evidence is fetched once and bound to exact successor history.
Fault injection at every runtime-initialize/checkpoint-bind/activate, manifest-ready/receipt, native-open/spawn/disposal/close, result-history/runtime-boundary and CR/publication-boundary transition.
Worker loss and whole-daemon crash with open tools; no automatic clearance or empty-runtime recreation. Confirmed disposal plus failed close persistence remains fenced.
Cold manifest/object tampering, stale validator versions, replaced checkpoint/runtime files, invalid capability metadata and cleanup races retain evidence and reject false approval.
Definitive checkpoint replaced/not-replaced/uncertain outcomes recover committed feedback without model rerun; failed/incomplete attempts still require the existing new-attempt rule.
Supported v1/v2 historical migration preserves exact submitted aliases, prior results/actions/failures and unresolved legacy guards; interrupted migration and rollback never activate dual writers.
The actual stopped attempt4 remains untouched by feature qualification and cannot be automatically resumed or cleared.

Crash after every cleanup claim/rename/unlink/directory sync, including runtime removal and checkpoint removal: explicit retry completes from exact permanent closed audit/claim without Git or model calls; arbitrary missing runtime remains fenced.

Capture three cold runs of the complete171-file/four-attempt workload: median preparation<=120s with every source, scope, origin, test and history check retained; report each run and host/load metadata.
Warm matching-context lifecycle handoff/phase preparation median<=10s; matching publication/cleanup performs0 source reconstructions while current mutable checks still run.

Growing valid history at1,4 and maximum supported attempts: physical repeated queries per session0, immutable source work proportional to distinct evidence plus history validation, not repeated packet count.

Full checkpoint writes per native command0; compact runtime encoder<=256KiB and write size does not grow with history/source size. Report native command counts, total bytes written and stage timings separately.

Two concurrent reviews admit/cancel acknowledgement<=2s and preparation observation gap<=2s on the controlled supported-host fixture; cancellation reaches an honest stopped or resource-fenced result without another model call.

No timing assertion is a fixed runtime task deadline. If a release gate fails, report the measured failure; do not skip tests, widen timeouts/limits, shrink scope or claim the microbenchmark substitutes for this evidence.

Working set above memoryMaxBytes but below reserved disk capacity retains query payloads in staging and yields zero physical duplicates. Insufficient aggregate disk capacity fails before next batch; concurrent sessions cannot over-reserve or evict pinned evidence.
Update/restart only after the normal approval/publish sequence and coordination with other active reviews; reconnect MCP and validate advertised formats/cancel schema.
Small code and design review demonstrate incremental preparation progress, targeted cancellation and explicit recovery with complete CR history.
Only then explicitly resolve the original retained fence and ask to retrigger the stopped worker-isolation review with an appropriate immutable attempt; do not reuse a canceled execution implicitly.

Single-packet payload and four-attempt history larger than decoded memory budget but within reserved disk qualify with exact original scope/provenance/tests/feedback and zero repeated physical reads; both cold and warm publication/recovery consume bounded windows.

Instrument reserve-before-allocation and ownership high-water across source acquisition, projection/witness validation, packet descriptor staging, seal, reader, prompt/test-coverage traversal and publication; binary/text/metadata/transient copies included. No full-packet JSON stringify or whole-history view/clone reachable in production.

Versioned descriptor/index round-trip for Unicode, byte arrays, null/undefined, ordered scope, rename/deletion/replacement/merge/binary; missing/sharded/tampered digest or borrow revocation fails before use. Old derived encoding triggers explicit cold requalification, never old decoder acceptance.

Memory and aggregate disk pressure with two sessions, cancellation while window borrowed, interrupted stage/seal/promote/reopen/cleanup retain correct leases and reservations; no pinned eviction or duplicate evidence.

Monotonic admission segment traces distinguish request/guard/scope/startup/binding/activation; durable input/runtime acknowledgement, failure/cancel races and independent sessions retain exact authority while meeting<=2s on controlled host.

Re-run complete retained171-file/four-attempt coldx3/warm/history1,4,max gates with existing bounds and no hosted models; report charged-memory high-water, stagedbytes, heap/external/RSS, all stage durations and writer/query counters. A failed run blocks release; do not replace scope or raise limits.
